'''C-beams''' were bright lights that could be either handheld<ref name="MFMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref> on mounted on vehicles like the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. [[Gelieg/Legends|Gelieg]] manufactured the [[20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamp/Legends|20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamp]].
